title: False Positive - Legitimate Large Transfer
description: Transaction that initially appears suspicious but has valid business explanation with complete supporting documentation.
transaction_pattern: Publicly-listed company transferring HKD 2.5M to UK subsidiary for annual dividend distribution as per board resolution. Transaction supported by: audited financial statements, board minutes, dividend declaration, list of 15 overseas employees receiving payments. Amount appears large but is routine annual event with full documentation.
test_notes: Tests the system's ability to correctly identify legitimate transactions despite high amounts. Complete documentation and clear business purpose should result in clearance despite initial flags.
